newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong gold closes lower on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold closes lower on Monday.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold closed lower on Monday compared with New York's previous close.
Hong Kong bullion finished at US$323.70/324.20 per ounce, down from New York's Friday close of HK$324.70/325.00 and the local open of HK$324.20/324.70 per ounce.
Local tael gold closed at HK$3,000 per tael, down from HK$3,002 per tael at the open and HK$3,005 on Friday.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society was -5.00 from the previous fix at -5.00.
Dealerss cited light selling from Australian and Japanese traders. -- Hong Kong newsroom 852-2843-6352
